title: Timed fieldwork practice questions and mark scheme, own questions
subject: Geography
source: Seeded from geography/y11 lesson 39 (Timed fieldwork practice questions and mark scheme, own questions (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 39: Timed Paper 1 practice: fieldwork section and feedback. Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: Core (timed, 20 minutes), Fieldwork (own questions): (a) Describe one method used to collect physical data and justify your choice. (4) (b) Using the table, calculate the mean channel depth at site 3: 0.32 m, 0.41 m, 0.36 m. (2) (c) Identify the anomaly in the data and suggest a reason. (2) (d) Evaluate the reliability of your conclusions. (8) (e) Suggest how the enquiry could be extended. (4)
questions.a: (a) method with equipment and justification (b) (0.32 + 0.41 + 0.36) / 3 = 0.363 m, about 0.36 m (c) value that breaks the downstream trend; e.g. debris or a pool (d) Level 3: methods, sampling, data quality, conclusion, judgement (e) more sites, other dates and seasons, more repeats, compare another river
questions.model: Teacher reads (a) aloud, then timing starts.

questions.q: Self-mark Section A from the last lesson and this section with the mark schemes; record scores and write two targets.
River velocity floats took 20 s, 22 s and 24 s over 10 m. Find the mean velocity.
questions.a: Mean time 22 s; velocity = 10 / 22 = about 0.45 m/s
questions.model: Mean time: (20 + 22 + 24) / 3 = 22 s. Velocity = distance / time. 10 / 22 = 0.45 m/s.
